question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Innocuous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Harmful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Innocuous"** means something that is not harmful or offensive; it is safe and harmless in nature. (निरापद)
 
 
• **Example:** The comment she made was completely innocuous and didn’t offend anyone.
 
 
• **"Harmful"** refers to something that can cause damage, injury, or negative effects. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is harmful to your health and can lead to serious medical conditions.
